comment: Trend_score = weighted blend of 4 components. Weights renormalize over whatever is available on a bar.
EMA ribbon: price location + stacking + slope. The smoothest, laggiest view.
Supertrend: direction plus distance from the line. Volatility-anchored.
ADX strength SIGNED by DI direction. Raw ADX is directionless.
Market structure: HH+HL vs LH+LL swing sequence. Discrete price action.
How each raw indicator maps onto the shared 0-100 scale.
ST_dist_pct treated as fully extended. Median on daily equities ~5pct.
ADX treated as a fully developed trend. Textbook 40 is too high for daily NSE data.
ADX below this = chop; the ADX sub-score stays at 50 instead of voting.
Cut points for Trend_band and the minimum evidence required.
Trend_score at or above this reads Strong Bull.
Trend_score at or above this reads Bull.
Trend_score at or above this reads Neutral.
Trend_score at or above this reads Bear; below it Strong Bear.
Components on the same side of 50 before agreement is confirmed vs mixed.
Components required before Trend_score is emitted at all.
Momentum_score = weighted blend of 4 components. Note these correlate 0.8-0.9 with each other.
RSI: normalized recent gains vs losses. Correlates ~0.9 with Stoch.
ROC: raw rate of change over the headline horizon.
MACD histogram: acceleration. The only component measuring something different.
Stochastic pctK: position in recent range. Noisiest of the four.
How each raw indicator maps onto the shared 0-100 scale.
MACD_hist_z treated as fully extended before the tanh squash.
Pulls pctK toward 50; below 1 damps the noisiest component.
Cut points for Momentum_band and minimum evidence required.
Momentum_score at or above this reads Strong Bullish.
Momentum_score at or above this reads Bullish.
Momentum_score at or above this reads Neutral.
At or above this reads Bearish; below it Strong Bearish.
Components on the same side of 50 before agreement is confirmed.
Components required before Momentum_score is emitted at all.
RSI at or above this plus Stoch overbought = flagged stretched.
RSI at or below this plus Stoch oversold = flagged stretched.
DIRECTIONLESS: 0=compressed, 100=expanded. NOT bearish-to-bullish. Never rank direction on this.
Bollinger bandwidth percentile. Close-based, ignores gaps.
ATR percentile. True-range based, so it reacts to overnight gaps.
Donchian width percentile. Tracks BB closely (corr ~0.93).
Keltner width percentile. Tracks ATR closely (corr ~0.96) - it IS ATR based.
All components ranked over the SAME window or the blend is incoherent.
Shared percentile window. BB is re-ranked here, not reusing bb_squeeze_win.
Volatility_score below this reads Very Low.
Below this reads Low.
At or above this reads High.
At or above this reads Very High.
Components required before Volatility_score is emitted.
Squeeze-capable components (BB, Keltner) that must agree for Confirmed.
Lookback for the expanding/contracting classification.
Score rise over that lookback counting as genuine expansion.
Bars after a squeeze in which expansion is still called a release.
Index rows must also exist in symbols.csv with kind=index.
Raw CSV filename stems in raw/equity, comma separated.
Prefixes used in field names, e.g. RS_NIFTY50_excess_pct.
Which benchmark drives RS_score and RS_state.
Bars for the excess-return window. 63 is about 3 months.
Outperformance pct treated as fully extended for RS_score.
Hidden fields are still COMPUTED - every score uses them. Hiding only affects the written CSV.
Set to 1 to ignore hidden_fields entirely and emit all columns. Fastest way to get everything back.
Comma-separated. Delete a name from this list to make that column reappear. Date/OHLCV can never be hidden.
Adjust with care: these change every downstream score.
EMA ribbon periods, fast to slow.
Supertrend ATR period.
Supertrend ATR multiplier. Consider 4 for volatile smallcaps.
ADX and DI period.
Skip symbols with fewer rows. 250 is where EMA_200 becomes meaningful.
Sequential gate over Stage->Trend->Momentum->Volume->Volatility. NOT an average of the 5 scores.
Trend_score above this permits a long.
Trend_score below this permits a short.
Stage_confidence below this = regime unclear, stand aside.
0 = long-only book; stage-4 setups become STAND ASIDE.
1 = thin volume downgrades a confirmed entry to ENTER SMALL.
Volatility_score above this + expanding = late, size down.
Numeric companion to Final_decision. 50=neutral, >50 long-actionable, <50 short. Gate sets a ceiling; strength fills it.
Max score once the stage gate blocks (pinned neutral).
Max once trend is unconfirmed or ambiguous.
Max once momentum is stretched or diverging.
Max once volume is thin.
Max once a confirmed setup is volatility-extended.
Weight of Trend in the directional fill.
Weight of Momentum.
Weight of volume confirmation.
Weight of stage confidence.
